name: Payday 2: Restoration Mod
summary: The Restoration Mod is a complete overhaul mod for Payday 2 that aims to provide a more engaging and varied experience. It completely overhauls skill trees, perk decks, weapons, enemies, enemy AI, stealth, and virtually every other aspect of gameplay. In addition, the overhaul adds a host of additional content; such as new masks, weapons, enemies, randomized time of day, and heists.
